scope.population: 72 pairs of arms over 2 containers declared in checks/contrast_declarations.py, judged on 44248 leaf comparisons
scope.window: n/a: this gate compares leaves of a results file against each other and reads no market data; the window is whatever the artifact under test declares
scope.coins: n/a: whatever the artifact under test declares

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

not_caught: a confound the manifest does not name. This gate re-measures the held-equal list it is given and nothing else, so an axis declared carelessly is checked carelessly

a held-equal quantity whose address is not relative to an arm. The recapture fraction, the headline horizon and the eligible-wallet count are shared by both arms by construction and no walk of the two arms reaches them; they are named unreachable and not counted as checked
a middle-state pair that should have been a claim. Moving a pair there is a decision written by hand, and this gate checks that somebody wrote it, never that they were right to
a measurement the artifact does not print. Two arms differing in something neither records have no leaf to differ at
a confound entering through a shared input rather than through the arms: two arms reading one stale column agree perfectly, and that is chk_input_freshness's question

asks: whether the two arms of each published difference differ along the one axis their manifest names, and before that, whether anybody has said which pairs are claims at all. Neither is asked by the freshness, provenance or register gates: each of those asks whether it is the same NUMBER, and none asks whether the comparison is a comparison
does_not_ask: whether any contrast is sound. This gate sorts nothing into axis, consequence and confound, and prints no word that could be read as approval: an instrument certifying a contrast would report success where there may be none, which is the direction of error that passes a review

predicate.declared_a_comparison: a manifest at the declared address names both arms and the delta block marks the difference published
predicate.declared_not_a_comparison: both arms are named in the hand-written ranking-only list and no manifest publishes the pair, or the producer refused the manifest
predicate.not_declared: everything else, which is the finding

states.population: 72 pairs over 2 containers, being every pair of arms each container holds

read_from_the_artifact_not_restated.grounds_text_this_run: a ranking orders arms on one metric; it does not make any two of them comparable. Every difference below declares the ONE axis its arms are allowed to differ on, lists what is held equal, measures each of those on the published leaves, and is withheld if any of them missed
read_from_the_artifact_not_restated.why: a check that retypes the rule it checks goes on asserting the old rule after the rule is fixed, and its disagreement then looks like a finding without being one. The producer's own `holds` fields are the exception: those are compared, never read

decided_by_hand.reason: the work publishes a difference for the pairs its manifests name, and an ordering over every arm. Those are different claims. A difference is made only where the arms were built to be equal on everything but one axis, which for this bake-off means a solved equal-width construction, and the producer solves it for the pairs it publishes and no others. Any other pair differs in realised quote width as well as in rule, and since the recapture books a printed fill to the arm whatever the arm quoted, standing wider is free and such a difference would be confounded. The work does not make it, so this gate does not ask what its axis was. The grounds are the producer's own and are read at grounds_at.
decided_by_hand.why_named_one_by_one: written as 'everything else' the third state could never fire, and a rule that cannot fire is not a rule

frozen_debt.why_empty: the 28 were pairs of a six-arm bake-off differing in realised quote width under published cost differences. The bake-off was recomputed with three arms solved onto one target width, and the 0.636 bps figure this gate was written for is no longer a published difference

coverage_must_stay_silent.why: both arms stand in the ordering the bake-off publishes and no manifest names the pair, so the work makes no claim about their difference. Before the three states existed this pair was reported as a missing declaration, and 36 such reports on one run is how a gate teaches people to stop reading it

coverage_must_fire.what: an arm placed in a fixture container that appears in no manifest and in no ranking_only_arms list
coverage_must_fire.why: taken from the live tree this case would empty the day the arm is declared, leaving a gate that reports nothing and cannot be shown able to report anything. Two instruments of this project failed that way on 2026-08-03, which is why it is injected

held_equal_must_stay_silent.why: the equal-width solve lands as_toxicity_plus_global's pooled mean extra half spread at 6.364595937112404 against bbgl's 6.364595937112405, a relative gap of 1.4e-16 against the 1e-09 the producer declares, and the late-fill count and the finite-extra count agree exactly at 1234777. Three of its seven declared held-equal quantities are addressable under an arm and are the three re-measured here; the other four -- the shared global leg, the wallet count carrying a wallet-specific premium, the recapture fraction and the headline horizon -- are settings and solve fields shared by both arms by construction, which no walk of the arms can reach and which this gate reports as unreachable rather than counting as checked. 400 leaves under both arms do differ, so the silence is a measured agreement on the declared list and not an empty comparison

held_equal_must_fire.what: a fixture manifest whose declared held-equal address carries a different value in the two arms, once inside the declared tolerance and once outside it
held_equal_must_fire.why: all three published differences hold today, so there is no live case. The pair of injections also calibrates the TOLERANCE, which a single case cannot: the producer declares rtol 1e-09 on the solved width and 0.0 on the counts, and one published difference lands at 2.9e-16 relative. A comparator demanding exact equality would call that a breach, and one ignoring the declared tolerance would pass a real one

HOW a fixed budget of defensive width is allocated: per counterparty wallet, from that wallet's own early adverse-selection estimate (arm a), against per coin plus per toxicity decile (arm b)
pairs.axis: HOW a fixed budget of defensive width is allocated: per counterparty wallet, from that wallet's own early adverse-selection estimate (arm a), against per coin plus per toxicity decile (arm b)
pairs.consequence_of_the_axis: the share of fills widened and the floor of the widening. An allocation that spends the whole budget on wallets with a positive score necessarily widens on fewer fills and reaches zero on the rest, while one that carries a market-wide leg widens on every fill and never goes below that leg. These follow from the axis and are reported, not held equal -- holding them equal would delete the axis.

manifest_not_held_equal.classified: CONFOUND on the per-coin rows and held equal on the pooled row only. The pass-through is one scalar per wallet and a wallet trades both coins, so a per-coin solve would quote one counterparty two unrelated prices. The pooled difference is the equal-width finding; the per-coin rows are reported for shape and are NOT it.
